name: Westfall Twp Municipal Building
paragraphs: Kobalt Construction built this municipal garage and office facility for Westfall Township from the ground up, giving the township's public works department a modern home for its vehicles and equipment.
The finished building features multiple drive-in bays, accessible entrances, and dedicated office space — a functional, durable facility built to serve the township for decades to come.
summary: Ground-up municipal garage and office building construction.
